title: Porthole Science
html:
Quest Giver: Audrey the Alchemist

Quest Type: Search and Destroy

Quest Description: Find the Porthole Laboratory on Level 7 of Algernon. Find and kill FRaNK the guardian, get his key, and use it to loot energy cores from 5 S.T.I.L.L.s.

Quest Reward: 5250 Gold

Return to: Audrey the Alchemist

Repeatable: No

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Find the way to Porthole Laboratories off of Level 7 of Algernon. When there, take out the designer of the experimental S.T.I.L.L. AL-V. Also use his key to collect 5 S.T.I.L.L. AL-V Energy Cores (for science!) and return to Audrey the Alchemist in Townston.

Offer:

Good work back there Dungeon Runner. Your personal experiment with the S.T.I.L.L. AL-V will delay production of this new FizzStar, but not for very long. To make matters worse, the designer of the S.T.I.L.L. AL-V by now has learned how to make the refiner less prone to explosions.

The designer the Whiskers hired is an old Fade scientist who goes by the name FRaNK. It's supposed to stand for Fade designeR and Noob Killer, who knows if that's true or not. I need you to head down to FRaNK's lab in Porthole Laboratories off of Level 7 of Algernon. When you find him, convince him to halt production of the new refiners any way you can. I suggest taking him apart and throwing the pieces into fire, but that may not be possible.

While you are there, shut down some of his experimental S.T.I.L.L. AL-Vs and collect their energy cores. You will need the key he carries to shut them down. When you are finished, come back and see me, Audrey the Alchemist, here in Townston. There will be cake.

Turn-in:

This was a triumph. I'm making a note here: HUGE SUCCESS. I hate to admit it, but I lied about the cake to get your help. But I do have this for you. Now if you could excuse me, there is still science to be done.

Objectives:

  • Disassemble FRaNK
  • FRaNK's Key ×1
  • Energy Cores ×5

Level range: 7–20
